name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static site content, TLS and security settings, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, runtime directories, and cleanup of generated replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, Git, a virtual environment, dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn on port 8000.
